description: SEO and AISO (AI Search Optimization) toolkit. AISO: check whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini and 6 more AI platforms can reach, read and cite your site: crawlers, llms.txt, citability, E-E-A-T, JSON-LD, brand mentions, agent readiness. interface.shortDescription: SEO and AISO toolkit: get your site found, read and cited by AI answer platforms
interface.longDescription: Free lite edition of RAINMOJO SO for anyone who wants their website reached, read and cited by AI answer platforms. 43 skills and 17 orchestrating agents cover AI crawler access bound to a 68-token crawler registry, readiness checklists for all ten documented AI answer platforms, AI agent readiness (semantic HTML and the accessibility tree), citability, content and schema review, llms.txt, brand mentions with sampled AI answers, keyword research and clustering, competitor and content gap analysis, topical authority, internal linking, image optimization, local SEO, backlink strategy, technical audit, two-round comparison, a Two-Tier presentation layer (a summary card in chat on any AI host plus the full report), and a content production chain that publishes WordPress drafts. Every result is a checklist or a count, never a weighted score, and every output is a recommendation the site owner applies. Built by BIQDADDY, the agency behind RAINMOJO.
